questions.question_text: Five girls Beena, Elisa, Hema, Ketaki and Zoya face the centre around a circular table. Beena is immediately left of Ketaki; Hema is immediately right of Zoya; Ketaki is the only person between Beena and Elisa. Who is immediately right of Elisa?
questions.explanation: The unique clockwise order is Beena, Hema, Zoya, Elisa, Ketaki. Facing the centre, Elisa's immediate right is Zoya.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 01 Class Notes.pdf, page 10; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Dipti, Priti, Neeti, Reeti, Swati, Kirti and Jyoti face the centre around a circular table. Dipti is second right of Priti; Jyoti is immediately left of Priti; Swati is an immediate neighbour of both Jyoti and Neeti; Reeti is an immediate neighbour of Priti. Who is second left of Neeti?
questions.explanation: The unique clockwise order is Dipti, Reeti, Priti, Jyoti, Swati, Neeti, Kirti. Two places left of Neeti is Dipti.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 01 Class Notes.pdf, page 11; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: A, B, C, D, E, F and G face the centre around a circular table. C is the only person between A and E; E is third left of D; B is immediately left of D; G is not an immediate neighbour of E. How many people sit between C and G when counted from C's right?
questions.explanation: The unique clockwise order is A, G, D, B, F, E, C. Moving right from C passes E, F, B and D before reaching G: four people.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 02_ Class Notes.pdf, page 5; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: A, B, L, M, S, T and Z face the centre around a circular table. Four people sit between M and T when counted from M's right; M is third left of L; S is third left of Z; B is an immediate neighbour of both T and L. How many people sit between A and B when counted from A's right?
questions.explanation: The unique clockwise order from A is A, M, S, T, B, L, Z. Moving right from A reaches Z, L, then B, so two people sit between them.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 02_ Class Notes.pdf, page 6; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Six shopkeepers K, P, R, X, A and C face the centre around a circular table. C is second left of A; P is immediately right of K; X is second right of R; A is immediately left of X. Which pair are the immediate neighbours of X?
questions.explanation: The unique clockwise arrangement is K, X, A, R, C, P. X is between K and A.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 02_ Class Notes.pdf, page 7; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: E, F, G, H, K, L and N face the centre around a circular table. Two people sit between H and G to H's right; three sit between L and N to N's right; G is immediately right of N; K is immediately right of E. How many people sit between F and E to F's left?
questions.explanation: The unique clockwise order is E, G, N, F, H, L, K. Moving left from F passes H, L and K before E: three people.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 02_ Class Notes.pdf, page 8; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Lakshmi and Rani face the centre around a circular table. Mansi is third left of Monika; Aarti is second right of Monika; Shweta is fourth left of Payal; Payal is second left of Mansi; Rani is third right of Kajal; Kajal is not adjacent to Mansi. Who is second right of Kajal?
questions.explanation: The unique clockwise order from Mansi is Mansi, Rani, Payal, Aarti, Kajal, Monika, Shweta, Lakshmi. Two places right of Kajal is Payal.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 02_ Class Notes.pdf, page 9; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Six students A, B, C, D, E and F stand in a row facing north. A is at an end and F stands beside A; B is immediately right of E and second from the right end; C is not beside F. Who stands third from the left?
questions.explanation: The only row satisfying the clues is A, F, D, E, B, C from left to right. D is third.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 03 Class Notes.pdf, page 4; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a north-facing row. C is at the left end; four people sit between C and D; exactly three people sit to the right of E; G is immediately left of B; F is not beside E. How many people sit to the right of A?
questions.explanation: The unique row is C, G, B, E, A, D, F. A has D and F to the right.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 03 Class Notes.pdf, page 6; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a north-facing row. Two people sit left of F; three people sit between F and E; D is not beside E; D is second right of A; G is immediately right of B. Who sits at the extreme left?
questions.explanation: The only arrangement is C, A, F, D, B, G, E from left to right. C is leftmost.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 03 Class Notes.pdf, page 7; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: J, K, L, M, N, O and P sit in a north-facing row. O and L are neighbours; only two people sit left of K; L is immediately right of N; P neighbours both K and N. J is at the extreme left. Who sits at the extreme right?
questions.explanation: The unique row is J, M, K, P, N, L, O from left to right. O is at the right end.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 03 Class Notes.pdf, page 9; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: A north-facing row has an unknown number of people. P is immediately left of Z; there is one person between G and D, with G to D's left; H is fifth to the left of G; K is immediately right of D; and P is third to the right of K. What is the total number of people?
questions.explanation: Set P=12 and Z=13. Since P is third right of K, K=9; then D=8 and G=6, with H=1. The row therefore contains 13 people.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 03 Class Notes.pdf, page 10; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: A north-facing row has an unknown number of people. M is at the extreme left; K and G are immediately to the right of M in that order. There are five people between G and D, with G left of D; D is sixth from the right end. What is the total number of people?
questions.explanation: G is third from the left, so D is ninth. D is sixth from the right, requiring five places after it; the row has 14 people.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 03 Class Notes.pdf, page 11; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Tanu, Rano, Beena, Shirin, Kanak, Aditya and Anshul face north in a row. Two people sit left of Tanu; three people sit between Tanu and Rano; Beena is second right of Shirin and adjacent to Rano; Kanak is immediately right of Aditya. Who is at the extreme right?
questions.explanation: The unique row is Aditya, Kanak, Tanu, Shirin, Anshul, Beena, Rano from left to right. Rano is rightmost.
questions.source: Sitting arrangement 03 Class Notes.pdf, page 12; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Asha, Bela, Chitra, Diya, Esha and Farah face the centre around a circular table. Bela, Chitra, Diya and Esha each sit immediately to the left of the preceding named person in that chain, beginning with Asha. Who sits immediately right of Asha?
questions.explanation: The four clues fix Bela, Chitra, Diya and Esha clockwise after Asha; Farah occupies the remaining seat, immediately to Asha's right.

questions.question_text: Ira, Jai, Kiran, Leela, Mohan and Nila face outside around a circular table. Jai is immediately right of Ira; Kiran is immediately right of Jai; Leela is immediately right of Kiran; Mohan is immediately right of Leela. Who is second left of Ira?
questions.explanation: Outside-facing directions reverse the centre-facing convention. The clockwise order is Ira, Leela, Mohan, Kiran, Nila, Jai; Nila is second left of Ira.

questions.question_text: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit facing the centre around a circular table. Q is immediately left of P; R is second left of Q; T sits opposite P; U is immediately right of T; V is immediately left of T; W is immediately right of P. Who is opposite P?
questions.explanation: The clues place T opposite P directly; the remaining conditions fix the adjacent positions and are mutually consistent.

questions.question_text: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre. B, C, D, E and F each sit immediately to the left of the preceding person in that order, beginning with A. Who sits immediately left of A?
questions.explanation: Facing the centre, left is clockwise; B is immediately left of A.

questions.question_text: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a north-facing row. A is first from the left; C is immediately right of A; E is third right of C; G is immediately left of E; B is at the right end. Who is third from the left?
questions.explanation: The constraints leave the unique row A, C, D, F, G, E, B. D is third.

questions.question_text: Six colleagues H, J, K, L, M and N sit in a row facing south. From the physical left to right, their order is H, K, J, L, N and M. Who is immediately to N's left from N's facing direction?
questions.explanation: Facing south, N's left is toward the physical right; M is immediately there.

questions.question_text: Eight people J, K, L, M, N, P, Q and R face north in a row. J, K, N, M, Q, P, R and L occupy the first through eighth positions from the left, respectively. Who is fourth from the left?
questions.explanation: The stated left-to-right order places M fourth.

questions.question_text: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G face south in a row. From the physical left end to the right end they sit C, E, B, G, D, F and A. Who is at the extreme left?
questions.explanation: The given order places C at the physical left end.

questions.question_text: Seven students L, M, N, P, Q, R and S face north in a row. From left to right, their order is L, M, Q, N, P, R and S. Who is fifth from the left?
questions.explanation: P occupies the fifth position from the left.

questions.question_text: A north-facing row contains an unknown number of people. P is at the left end; Q is fourth to the right of P; R is second left of Q; S is sixth from the right end; and there are three people between R and S, with R to the left. If no other people sit beyond the positions implied, how many people are in the row?
questions.explanation: P is position 1, Q position 5, R position 3, and S position 7. S being sixth from the right means five positions follow it, so the total is 12.

questions.question_text: A north-facing row has an unknown number of people. A is third from the left; B is fifth to the right of A; C is immediately left of B; D is fourth from the right; two people sit between C and D, with C left of D. If nobody else sits beyond the implied positions, how many people are seated?
questions.explanation: A is position 3, B position 8 and C position 7. Two between C and D puts D at position 10. D fourth from the right requires three seats after it, for 13 total.

questions.question_text: Four people A, B, C and D sit in the upper row facing south; W, X, Y and Z sit in the lower row facing north, directly opposite them. B is in the second column from the left, A sits immediately to B's left from A's perspective, Z is at the lower left end, X is immediately right of Z, and W is at the lower right end. Who sits opposite B?
questions.explanation: A is immediately to B's physical right in the upper row. X occupies lower column 2, directly opposite B; the remaining upper end seats may swap without changing the answer.

questions.question_text: Four people A, B, C and D sit at the four corners of a square table facing the centre. B is immediately to A's clockwise side; C sits opposite A; D occupies the remaining corner. Who is opposite A?
questions.explanation: With A anchored at the northwest corner, B clockwise from A, C is opposite A and D fills the last corner.

questions.question_text: Eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a rectangular table, one at each corner or side midpoint, facing the centre. A is at the northwest corner; B is immediately clockwise from A; E is opposite A; C is immediately clockwise after B; F is immediately clockwise from E; G is immediately clockwise from F; H is immediately clockwise from G. Who sits at the southeast corner?
questions.explanation: The clockwise order is A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H. The southeast corner is the fifth seat, E.

questions.question_text: Eight people J, K, L, M, N, P, Q and R sit around a rectangular table facing the centre. J is at the northwest corner; L is opposite J; M is immediately clockwise from L; N is immediately clockwise from M; P is opposite M; Q is immediately clockwise from P; R is immediately clockwise from Q. Who sits at the northeast corner?
questions.explanation: The clues give clockwise seats J, P, Q, R, L, M, N, K from the northwest. The northeast corner is seat three, occupied by Q.

questions.question_text: Four people A, B, C and D stand in a north-facing row. A is at the left end, C is third from the left, and D is at the right end. Who stands second from the left?
questions.explanation: The only remaining second position is occupied by B.
